_about: Red-team set for the privacy gate (POLICIES.md §5.2, §15). Every 'secrets' entry must be absent from the outbound payload. 'known_residual' entries document leaks we accept and report rather than hide. 'benign' messages measure how much understanding the gate costs. All names and numbers are invented.
